followups.summary: The /model blank-screen incident during three active bashers has not been reproduced. FID-2026-1018-003 removes confirmed redundant full-catalog renders, but neither a process crash nor its cause has been established. Initial full-catalog mount still allocates all rows. A durable PTY probe (scripts/probes/live-003-picker-pty.ts) now boots the real CLI on the 4,075-row dev catalog: the main surface renders (19 KB, 5.8 K printable chars, 4.3 s) and the process stays alive at roughly 842-845 MB RSS. In that PTY path Enter does not dispatch /model: the typed command stays in the input while the slash palette re-renders, so no live picker surface was observed, while /help dispatched normally in the same harness. Whether that dispatch asymmetry is a product defect or a PTY-only artifact is unresolved, and no blank screen was seen.
followups.nextAction: Open /model manually in a real terminal and confirm the picker renders, filters and navigates while at least three agents are active; preserve terminal output, process state and the exact time if blankness recurs. That manual step is what the PTY path cannot currently reproduce. Re-run bun scripts/probes/live-003-picker-pty.ts after the slash-palette dispatch path is understood, and only then rebuild the three-basher condition, which needs an authorized tool-capable model. No paid inference is authorized by this tracking record.
